- [**Oberalp Bike**\\
\\
RouteSedrun\\
\\
The circular bike route from Sedrun to the Maighels Hut first leads straight to the source of the Rhine before crossing the Oberalp Pass and returning to Sedrun. Pleasant resting areas, SAC Huts and restaurants along the route entice you to take a break.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/maighelshuette-oberalppass/)
- [**Oberalp Jam**\\
\\
EventAndermattFebruary 19, 2027\\
\\
Musical entertainment on the terrace of the Piz Calmot mountain inn](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/events/oberalp-jam/)
- [**Vier-Quellen-Weg, Stage 1/5**\\
\\
RouteAndermatt\\
\\
From the Oberalppass, a steep climb leads to the source of the Rhine at the Tomasee lake. After hiking through the wetlands of Val Maighels you start the climb to the Maighelspass and the idyllic Portgerensee lake. This is followed by the descent to the Vermigel Hut.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/vier-quellen-weg-49_01/)
- [**Walserweg, Stage 13/19**\\
\\
RouteDavos\\
\\
Round-timber construction in Monstein and on Oberalp. Across the pastureland of the former «Meder» (hay meadows) on Fanezfurgga. The trail leads through the fossil-rich Ducan area, to the waterfall and Sertig village. «Hinter den Eggen» Church dating from 1699.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/walserweg-35_13/)
- [**Rhine Route, Stage 1/9**\\
\\
RouteAndermatt\\
\\
The sparkling source of the Rhine rises in the Oberalp region close to the pass. In Val Tujetsch lies one of the richest and most fascinating sources of mineral deposits in the Alps and also the monastery village of Disentis.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/rhine-route-2_01/)
- [**Sedrun Ride**\\
\\
ExperienceSedrun\\
\\
The Sedrun winter sports region on the Graubünden side of the Oberalp Pass is especially popular with families and beginners. But even the more demanding skiers enjoy the most beautiful piste in the area – the pleasantly wide Sedrun Ride from Cuolm Val to Dieni.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/sedrun-ride/)
- [**Berggasthaus Piz Calmot**\\
\\
RestaurantSedrun\\
\\
The Piz Calmot mountain inn is located at the top of the Oberalp Pass at 2,048 meters above sea level, in the immediate vicinity of the source of the Rhine.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/food-wine/restaurant/berggasthaus-piz-calmot/)
- [**Camona da Cavardiras CAS**\\
\\
AccommodationDisentis\\
\\
In the midst of the mountains between the Maderaner Valley and Surselva, in the Oberalpstock region.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/camona-da-cavardiras-cas/)
- [**The rolling bartender.**\\
\\
Story\\
\\
Each day, Victor Costa covers 6,000 vertical metres with the après-ski train. From his new home in Andermatt (Uri) over the Oberalp Pass to Disentis (Graubünden) and back, twice each way.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/winter/stories/the-rolling-bartender/)
- [**Badus Hut, Lake Toma**\\
\\
AccommodationSedrun\\
\\
The cozy, small house is located at 2,503 meters above Lake Toma, the source of the Rhine. The hut is reached from the Oberalp Pass via Pazolastock or from Maighels in two to three hours.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/badus-hut-lake-toma/)
- [**Alpine Bike, Stage 9/16**\\
\\
RouteDisentis\\
\\
The ascent to Uaul Cavorgia is perspiration producing but rewarding in terms of flora and views. Sparser in Val Maighels on the way up to the Oberalppass then truly high-Alpine. The terrific single trail demands top biking techniques.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/alpine-bike-1_09/)
- [**Glacier Express Route Private Tour from Zurich**\\
\\
OfferZurichNovember 15, 2026\\
\\
Discover the Glacier Express route on a private train journey in 2nd class from Zurich. Visit Chur, Disentis, and Andermatt, and travel through the Rhine Gorge via the Oberalp Pass.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/glacier-express-route-private-tour-from-zurich/)
- [**Sedrun**\\
\\
Place\\
\\
Sedrun in Graubünden: hike to the source of the Rhine, ski in the Andermatt–Sedrun area and discover a lighthouse more than 2,000 metres above sea level at the Oberalp Pass.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/sedrun/)
- [**Matterhorn Gotthard Bahn – the Alpine adventure railway**\\
\\
ExperienceBrig\\
\\
The Matterhorn Gotthard Bahn is an Alpine adventure railway par excellence. The line is 144 kilometres long, running from Zermatt to Disentis and from Andermatt to Göschenen, covering a difference in altitude of 3,300 metres, passing through 33 tunnels and galleries, and crossing 126 bridges and viaducts along the way. The lowest point of the journey is Visp, at 625 metres above sea level, and the highest the Oberalppass at 2,033 metres above sea level.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/matterhorn-gotthard-bahn-the-alpine-adventure-railway/)
- [**Ski touring on Piz Badus**\\
\\
ExperienceSedrun\\
\\
Tips for ski tours to the source of the Rhine This four-hour ski tour on the Gotthard massif takes you up 2,928-metre Piz Badus before descending more than 1,300 metres via the Maighelshütte to Tschamut.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/ski-touring-on-piz-badus/)
- [**Grand tour on two wheels**\\
\\
ExperienceOberalp\\
\\
The great thing about this route is that it is almost entirely downhill – and takes in the wonderful natural variety of Eastern Switzerland…](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/grand-tour-on-two-wheels/)
- [**Cycling holidays Rhine Route Vorderrhein & Rhine Valley**\\
\\
OfferAndermattMay 4, 2027\\
\\
Ruinalta gorge and Lake Constance The Rhine Route spans the east of Switzerland in a wide arc.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/cycling-holidays-rhine-route-vorderrhein-rhine-valley/)
- [**Cycling holidays Rhine Route Andermatt - Basel**\\
\\
OfferAndermattMay 4, 2027\\
\\
Ruinaulta gorge, Lake Constance, Rhinefall The Rhine Route spans the east of Switzerland in a wide arc.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/cycling-holidays-rhine-route-andermatt-basel-1/)
- [**Senda Sursilvana, Stage 1/5**\\
\\
RouteAndermatt\\
\\
A section that particularly delights flora lovers. But those with an interest in geology will constantly look up towards summits known to hold mountain crystal. The interesting composition of the route makes this section a “kings stage”.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/senda-sursilvana-85_01/)
- [**Senda Sursilvana, Stage 3/5**\\
\\
RouteDisentis\\
\\
The mountain tour starts in Sumvitg and follows the left flank of the valley up to Brigels. High above the valley basin of the Surselva, the Senda Sursilvana meanders alongside the mountain flanks. En route we come across steep mountain streams that later flow into the Vorderrhein. The hiking tour leads through picturesque villages in Graubünden.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/senda-sursilvana-85_03/)
